task.title: Episode and arc consolidation
task.classification: cross-boundary Roleplay storage, prompt assembly, remote runtime, and UI change

coreClaim: Eligible Roleplay transcripts consolidate into deterministic, non-overlapping episode and arc projections without displacing recent transcript or atomic memory, while source mutations safely stale only the affected story chain.
rootCause: Roleplay had atomic memories and scene or rolling summaries, but no canonical long-form story projection with stable coverage, invalidation, regeneration, or bounded prompt ownership.

inScope: Ordinary 24-message episode boundaries and manual assistant-boundary closure
Whole-scene episodes from the existing formal scene conclusion pass
Deterministic canonical provenance, overlap enforcement, stale cascades, and supersession
Fenced chronological background consolidation with retry and backfill
Independent bounded Story Continuity prompt selection and attribution
Roleplay Story inspection and actions with a per-chat automatic-build opt-out
Embedded Tauri and hostable HTTP runtime parity
outOfScope: Migration or deletion of legacy summaries
Silent mass backfill of existing chats

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Active Roleplay story slots have exact ordered source provenance, cannot overlap unrelated slots, stale safely after source changes, and enter prompts only through an independent lower-priority bounded selector.
claimBoundary.riskType: canonical storage projections, prompt continuity, legacy defaults, and cross-entrypoint mutation behavior
entrypoints: Story Continuity modal and Roleplay HUD actions
currentPathsOrFormats: canonical-memories episode records remain authoritative story projections
canonical-memories summary records with level arc remain authoritative arc projections
story_projection prompt attribution carries exact source coverage
legacyPathsOrFormats: Existing chats without enableStoryConsolidation use the effective Roleplay plus Memory Recall default
Legacy visual_novel chats normalize to Roleplay behavior
Existing rolling summaries, scene summaries, atomic memories, and scene-history records remain compatible and are not migrated
Conversation and Game chats remain outside automatic consolidation
outOfScopeClaims: The change does not claim model prose is deterministic.
The change does not claim existing chats are silently fully backfilled.
The change does not reactivate stale or superseded projections.
The change does not replace atomic canonical memory.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: src/engine had no owner for durable long-form Roleplay coverage and no way to coordinate it with src-tauri canonical persistence or prompt selection.
contractLaneGate.producer: src/engine generation modules own eligibility, boundaries, deterministic job intent, summarization, and bounded selection; src-tauri atomically persists and invalidates projections.
contractLaneGate.consumer: src/features exposes Roleplay-only controls through src/shared/api, and prompt assembly consumes the independent Story Continuity selection.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: src/engine owns product meaning, src/shared/api owns runtime adaptation, src-features owns interaction, and src-tauri owns privileged storage, lease, overlap, and transaction mechanics.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: Typed ports schedule one chronological fenced job; explicit shared adapters route embedded and remote commands; Rust validates leases, exact coverage, source ordering, overlap, and replacement commit ordering atomically.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: src/engine is the primary product owner, with src-tauri as the native persistence owner and src/shared/api as the transport boundary.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not move boundary cadence, summarization policy, prompt priority, or Roleplay enablement into src-tauri; Rust owns native mechanics and atomic validation, not product meaning.
regressionProof: story-projections.spec.ts proves eligible message filtering, assistant boundaries, formal-scene exclusion, exact contiguity, and four-episode arcs.
story-consolidation-queue.spec.ts proves deterministic scheduling, retries, chronological backfill, foreground yielding, regeneration, and opt-out boundaries.
canonical_memory.rs and memory_capture.rs tests prove overlap rejection, stale cascades, atomic replacement ordering, and failed-replacement preservation.
story-continuity-context.spec.ts and context-window.spec.ts prove independent bounded selection and lower prompt priority.
story-consolidation-runtime-api.spec.ts, remote-runtime.spec.ts, and architecture checks prove transport parity.

positiveRows.claim: An ordinary Roleplay episode closes at 24 eligible messages only on a saved assistant boundary.
positiveRows.evidence: story-projections.spec.ts passes threshold, hidden-row exclusion, active-swipe, exact contiguity, and assistant-boundary cases.

positiveRows.claim: A formal scene produces one source-backed episode from the same structured summary pass.
positiveRows.evidence: scene-service.spec.ts passes the whole-scene canonical episode assertion without a second model call.

positiveRows.claim: Four consecutive active episode slots form one non-overlapping arc and remain idempotent.
positiveRows.evidence: story-projections.spec.ts and story-consolidation-queue.spec.ts pass exact source-episode and stale-gap cases.

positiveRows.claim: Desktop and Pi runtime entrypoints expose the same fenced update and atomic commit commands.
positiveRows.evidence: story-consolidation-runtime-api.spec.ts, remote-runtime.spec.ts, pnpm check:architecture, and cargo check pass.

contradictionRows.claim: Hidden instructions, internal rows, inactive swipes, empty messages, and incomplete assistant boundaries must not enter episode coverage.
contradictionRows.evidence: story-projections.spec.ts passes negative eligibility and boundary rows.

contradictionRows.claim: A source edit, delete, hidden-state change, or active-swipe change must not stale unrelated projections or ordinary atomic memories.
contradictionRows.evidence: canonical_memory.rs and chats.rs focused Rust tests pass affected-chain-only invalidation assertions.

contradictionRows.claim: A failed initial or replacement job must not displace the last valid active projection.
Story projections must not consume the atomic-memory candidate limit or outrank mandatory recent history.
contradictionRows.evidence: story-continuity-context.spec.ts and context-window.spec.ts pass independent budget, raw-overlap, duplicate-removal, and priority rows.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing Roleplay and legacy visual_novel chats enable automatic consolidation only when Memory Recall is effectively enabled, unless explicitly opted out.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: story-consolidation-queue.spec.ts passes effective enablement, legacy normalization, explicit opt-out, and manual-action bypass cases.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing scene history, character memory, rolling summaries, and atomic memory behavior remain available.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: scene-service.spec.ts passes compatibility writes; prompt/context focused suites and full pnpm check pass.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing chats catch up one oldest uncovered episode per new reply unless the user explicitly requests full backfill.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: story-consolidation-queue.spec.ts passes chronological single-catch-up and Build existing story cases.

untestedRows: A live provider-backed Story modal workflow was not run against a real chat because it would create or mutate durable user chat data.
Model-specific narrative summary quality remains provider-dependent.

ownedFacts.description: Story projections are stored in canonical-memories while durable queue state is stored separately in story-consolidation-jobs.
ownedFacts.evidence: Storage collection constants, Rust contracts, canonical commit commands, generated schema, and storage-contract checks align.

ownedFacts.description: Replacement activation and old-projection supersession happen in one Rust atomic update after the replacement content exists.
Story Continuity is a separate prompt source below recent history and atomic canonical memory.
ownedFacts.evidence: Focused story-continuity and context-window tests pass, including exact attribution and overlap removal.

userActionCopy.description: Story consolidation is non-destructive, but Pi operators who want a pre-deploy snapshot can copy the mounted De-Koi data directory before updating.
userActionCopy.action: With De-Koi stopped, run cp -a /home/chai/de-koi-data /home/chai/de-koi-data-backup-1266 before deployment; normal deployment does not require this optional backup.
userActionCopy.companionFiles: Copy the entire mounted directory so canonical memories, jobs, indexes, chats, messages, and sidecars stay together.
detectedLayouts: Desktop and other host layouts use their configured De-Koi data directory; this PR does not migrate either layout.

manualBlockers.reason: Deterministic owner tests prove persistence and UI data contracts. The live mutation was deliberately skipped to avoid altering a real chat; Discover was browser-smoked.

verification.baselineEvidence: pnpm check passed on the final feature diff; warning-only knip output remained non-blocking.
